notes: doc_types: a document's type is set from its title, deterministically. The first pattern that matches wins; no match gives 'other'.

field_source_doc_types: only these document types can set an order's field values. Emails and other informal messages never set or contradict a field value (SPEC 8: a new email does not automatically modify a contract); what they say is kept as an observation for later phases.

placeholders: printed text that is not a value. 'not_applicable' text records the field as not applicable; 'awaited' text records it as pending with no value (for example a committed date not given yet). Matching ignores case and surrounding punctuation.
